text:
ana: Quick sync — we need to lock the MVP boundary by EOD Friday so we can commit the milestone. I sketched 3 launch slices (A/B/C). Quick reactions?
kevin: can you tl;dr what A/B/C contain and rough dev estimates?
ana: A = core chat + routing + baseline infra (~4w). B = integrations+webhooks (2w). C = admin/analytics (3w). My gut: ship A-only for MVP.
jules: design call: A is straightforward. B requires new UX patterns (settings + onboarding) — that'll blow the schedule. I'd move B -> v1.
maria: from CS: ACME (pilot) marked integrations as high priority — they said must-have for pilot onboarding unless we provide a manual workaround. Other pilots are fine with A.
sam: ops concern: shipping A-only keeps us within latency/cost SLOs. A+B would need extra reserved capacity and push infra work.
kevin: engineering nit: A is doable in 4 weeks but we must cut profile export and the fancy cache invalidation. Those are unblockers for the timeline. Otherwise risk to SLO and QA.
ana: proposal: decision rubric = (1) pilot/customer impact, (2) dev effort, (3) production risk (SLOs), (4) long-term maintenance. Folks agree?
kevin: +1 on rubric. Concrete trade: move profile export -> v1, provide ACME manual integration path for 6 weeks.
maria: ACME is ok with a manual workaround if we pair them with SE docs and 2 support sessions. They prefer integrations but will accept pilot if core works.
jules: design can deliver A flows by week 3 if we strip advanced settings. If we keep settings, timeline slips.
ana: decision then: MVP = slice A only. Cuts: profile export and advanced settings out of MVP. Owners: kevin (eng) for scope, jules (design) for UI, maria (CS) for pilot onboarding. I'll draft the rollout doc and update the board.
sam: note: this implies pushing our milestone target by 2 weeks. Current target -> will need reset from Apr 15 -> Apr 29 if we enforce cuts. Ops needs a formal sign-off.
kevin: accept the milestone shift. I'll update the sprint plan.
maria: :thumbsup: Will notify ACME and schedule two onboarding sessions.
release-bot: Milestone MVP-boundary locked by ana. Board updated: MVP-target -> 1835875200.
